title: Video reverse-engineering evidence (evidence.json)
description: Hard measurements of one video, written by the video_re_evidence_bundle code module. It is the 'disassembly' that analyst subagents cite. Every measured value is null when its tool was unavailable or failed, and then 'errors' says why; values are never invented. Units and methods are given per field. evidence.json is a local working file: it can contain caption text and keyframe paths from the analysed video, so it must not be published, and nothing in it except technique and structure may be copied into a format IR.

bbox.description: [x, y, w, h] in source pixels, display orientation (rotation applied), origin top-left.

reference.description: File name or URL the analyst was given. Never a copy of the media.

width.description: Display width in pixels after rotation metadata is applied.

height.description: Display height in pixels after rotation metadata is applied.

fps.description: Average frame rate of the first video stream (avg_frame_rate, falling back to r_frame_rate).

shots.description: Shots from video_re_detect_shots (hard cuts and gradual transitions), in time order. Per-shot fields are null when their module was unavailable.

keyframe.description: Path of the representative frame, relative to evidence.json (local analysis artefact; never redistributed).

palette.description: Dominant colours by k-means over sampled frames, sorted by area share, largest first.

motion_energy.description: Mean absolute grey-level difference between consecutive frames (0-255 scale, analysis width 160 px). center = central box of 60% x 60% of the frame; border = the rest of the frame.

camera.description: Global image motion by phase correlation plus a scale search. pan_x: frame widths per second, positive = camera moves right (content travels left). pan_y: frame heights per second, positive = camera moves down (content travels up). zoom: natural-log scale change per second, positive = zoom in. null when no reliable estimate.

text_regions.description: Text-like regions from an edge-density heuristic, sampled over time (default 2 samples per second). Region proposals, not OCR: textures and grids can produce false positives.

captions.description: Caption events from an embedded subtitle stream, a sidecar file, or OCR of the caption band (see details/video_re_caption_track.json for which). Text may be masked ('WORD {n} word') when the bundle ran with --text-mode masked, or empty with --text-mode none.

integrated_lufs.description: EBU R128 integrated loudness (ffmpeg ebur128), LUFS.

speech_segments.description: Speech-like segments from an energy/spectral heuristic (no neural VAD). Music with vocals or dense sound design can be counted as speech.

tempo_bpm.description: Tempo from autocorrelation of the onset envelope; null when no periodicity is found.

speech_wpm.description: Words per minute of speaking time: counted from a transcript when one exists, otherwise a syllable-rate estimate (see details/video_re_speech_rate.json for the method).

cuts_on_beat_ratio.description: Share of cuts within the tolerance (default 70 ms) of a tracked beat.

semi_transparent_ratio.description: Share of detected overlay-panel area whose estimated opacity is below 0.98 (the background visibly changes underneath). null when no panel was detected or the background never moves.

overlap_ratio.description: Share of the text region's area inside the zone.

tools.description: name -> version for every external tool, Python package and video_re module that ran.

errors.description: One entry per measurement that is null or partial, and why.
